# cr-ci bootstrap-gcp.sh (dry-run) project=example-project region=us-central1
# dry-run: nothing is changed; '?' lines are read-only checks, assumed to find nothing
# C1: APIs
+ gcloud services enable run.googleapis.com artifactregistry.googleapis.com secretmanager.googleapis.com cloudscheduler.googleapis.com cloudbuild.googleapis.com iam.googleapis.com storage.googleapis.com --project=example-project
# C2: service accounts (EXEC_SA_NAME must stay at zero roles)
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts create cr-runner-build-sa --project=example-project '--display-name=cr-ci image builds (Cloud Build)' '--description=cr-ci: image builds (Cloud Build)'
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts create cr-runner-mediator-sa --project=example-project '--display-name=cr-ci mediator service' '--description=cr-ci: mediator service'
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-scheduler-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts create cr-runner-scheduler-sa --project=example-project '--display-name=cr-ci reconcile scheduler' '--description=cr-ci: reconcile scheduler'
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-exec-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts create cr-runner-exec-sa --project=example-project '--display-name=cr-ci runner executions (no roles)' '--description=cr-ci: runner executions (no roles)'
# C3: Artifact Registry repository
? gcloud artifacts repositories describe cr-runners --location=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud artifacts repositories create cr-runners --repository-format=docker --location=us-central1 --project=example-project '--description=cr-ci runner and mediator images'
# C19: Cloud Build staging bucket (sources only; deleted after 7 days)
? gcloud storage buckets describe gs://example-project-cr-ci-staging --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud storage buckets create gs://example-project-cr-ci-staging --project=example-project --location=us-central1 --uniform-bucket-level-access --public-access-prevention --lifecycle-file=scripts/staging-lifecycle.json
# C5: secret containers (versions come from set-secrets.sh)
? gcloud secrets describe cr-runner-gh-app-private-key --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud secrets create cr-runner-gh-app-private-key --replication-policy=automatic --project=example-project
? gcloud secrets describe cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud secrets create cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret --replication-policy=automatic --project=example-project
# C4: BUILD_SA_NAME may push to ARTIFACT_REPO only
+ gcloud artifacts repositories add-iam-policy-binding cr-runners --location=us-central1 --project=example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/artifactregistry.writer --format=none
# C19: BUILD_SA_NAME reads the uploaded build sources in the staging bucket only
+ gcloud storage buckets add-iam-policy-binding gs://example-project-cr-ci-staging --project=example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/storage.objectViewer --format=none
# C7: BUILD_SA_NAME writes build logs (CLOUD_LOGGING_ONLY)
+ gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/logging.logWriter --condition=None --format=none
# C6: MEDIATOR_SA_NAME reads the two secrets only
+ gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding cr-runner-gh-app-private-key --project=example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor --format=none
+ gcloud secrets add-iam-policy-binding cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret --project=example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor --format=none
# C11: MEDIATOR_SA_NAME may act as EXEC_SA_NAME only
+ gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding cr-runner-exec-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser --format=none
# check: EXEC_SA_NAME holds no project roles
? gcloud projects get-iam-policy example-project '--flatten=bindings[].members' --filter=bindings.members:serviceAccount:cr-runner-exec-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com '--format=value(bindings.role)'
# done; next: set-secrets.sh, build-runner-image.sh
